name: thomast8-claude-plugins
description: Thomas Tiotto's Claude Code plugins, bundled into a single marketplace. One `/plugin marketplace add` command gives you access to all of them.

plugins.name: worktree-toolkit
plugins.description: Create git worktrees from PR numbers / branch names / a live picker (your open PRs and PRs needing your review), and reclaim worktree branches back into main. Graphite-aware. Bundles WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks so the session's project directory follows the worktree.

plugins.name: find-reviewer
plugins.description: `/find-reviewer` ranks contributors by load, breadth across the repo, and familiarity with the changed files, surfacing the most PR-active candidates first in a multi-select picker. Auto-detects the current branch's PR. Cached.

plugins.name: codex-pilot
plugins.description: Supervise Codex agents from Claude Code. Send work to a thread, steer a turn already running, stop one, answer its approval and permission requests, and change model, reasoning effort, plan mode or sandbox. Follow threads to learn when a turn finished without polling. Handles several Codex Desktop installs, and resumes a thread detached when the app does not have it open.
